description: Create or update a permanent short link and dynamic QR code for a file or PDF that is already hosted at a public URL. Use this as a fallback when the host cannot pass an attached file; prefer host_file for local or host-native attachments. When `qr_id` is provided, update the file destination while preserving the existing short link and QR code. Also used as the finalizer step by the in-chat upload form.

asset_iri.description: Optional QRCodeKIT asset IRI returned by an earlier upload.
asset_iri.title: Asset Iri

file_url.description: Already-hosted public file URL, preferably a QRCodeKIT asset URL.
file_url.title: File Url

original_filename.description: Original filename to show for the download. Defaults to 'file'.
original_filename.title: Original Filename

qr_id.description: Optional QRCodeKIT identifier for updating an existing QR instead of creating one.
qr_id.title: Qr Id

typology.description: Use 'file' for an arbitrary file or 'pdf' for a PDF.
typology.title: Typology

name: save_file_url_qr

destination_url.description: Current destination URL for the dynamic QR.
destination_url.title: Destination Url

qr_id.description: Stable QRCodeKIT identifier for the QR.
qr_id.title: Qr Id

qr_image_url.description: Primary public QR image URL, typically the generated SVG asset.
qr_image_url.title: Qr Image Url

qr_image_urls.description: Public QR image or download URLs keyed by format, such as svg, png, pdf, or eps.
qr_image_urls.title: Qr Image Urls

short_code.description: Short code segment used by the QR shortlink.
short_code.title: Short Code

shortlink_url.description: Complete public shortlink URL encoded by the QR.
shortlink_url.title: Shortlink Url

title.description: Human-readable title of the dynamic QR.
title.title: Title

visits_total.description: Total visits/scans recorded for this QR by QRCodeKIT.
visits_total.title: Visits Total

items.description: QR codes visible to the active account.
items.title: Items

title: Link a Hosted File
